lines.text: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace.
All my adversaries are before You.
Insults have broken my heart,
and I am in despair.
I looked for sympathy, but there was none,
for comforters, but I found no one.
They poisoned my food with gall
and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
May their table become a snare;
may it be a retribution and a trap.
May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see,
and their backs be bent forever.
Pour out Your wrath upon them,
and let Your burning anger overtake them.
May their place be deserted;
let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
For they persecute the one You struck
and recount the pain of those You wounded.
Add iniquity to their iniquity;
let them not share in Your righteousness.
May they be blotted out of the Book of Life
and not listed with the righteous.
But I am in pain and distress;
let Your salvation protect me, O God.

pictures.scene: Jorg Breu the Elder, De menigte roept tegen hem - the crowd pressing in with their mouths open against one man, You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace, all my adversaries are before You
pictures.name: pd_breu_de_menigte_roept_tegen_hem

pictures.scene: Nikolay Kasatkin, Wezen - orphan children left standing with nobody to take them in, insults have broken my heart and I am in despair
pictures.name: pd_kasatkin_wezen

pictures.scene: Jozef Israels, Het naaistertje - the young seamstress bent alone over her work in a bare room, I looked for sympathy but there was none, for comforters but I found no one
pictures.name: pd_israels_het_naaistertje

pictures.scene: Lucas Cranach the Elder, Kruisiging met de hoofdman - the sponge lifted on the reed to the Lord on the cross, they gave me vinegar to quench my thirst
pictures.name: pd_cranach_kruisiging_met_de_hoofdman

pictures.scene: Matthias Stom, Esau verkoopt zijn eerstgeboorterecht - the bowl set on the table and a birthright lost over it, may their table become a snare and a trap
pictures.name: pd_stom_esau_verkoopt_zijn_eerstgeboorterecht

pictures.scene: Aert van der Neer, Riviergezicht bij maanlicht - the river country sunk in darkness with only a thin moon on the water, may their eyes be darkened so they cannot see
pictures.name: pd_van_der_neer_riviergezicht_bij_maanlicht

pictures.scene: Wincenty Dmochowski, Bosbrand - the forest going up in a wall of fire, pour out Your wrath upon them and let Your burning anger overtake them
pictures.name: pd_dmochowski_bosbrand

pictures.scene: Julius von Klever, Winterlandschap met brug - an abandoned place under snow with no smoke and no one on the road, may their place be deserted, let there be no one to dwell in their tents
pictures.name: pd_klever_winterlandschap_met_brug

pictures.scene: Altobello Melone, Christus draagt het kruis - Christ under the cross with the mob jeering at the wounds already given Him, they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded
pictures.name: pd_melone_christus_draagt_het_kruis

pictures.scene: Adriaen Brouwer, Drinkende boeren in de herberg - men heaping one drunken night on the last in a smoky tavern, add iniquity to their iniquity, let them not share in Your righteousness
pictures.name: pd_brouwer_drinkende_boeren_in_de_herberg

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, Portret van een koopman - the merchant at his desk among the slips and ledgers where every name is written down, may they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_portret_van_een_koopman

pictures.scene: Giovanni Bellini, Gebed in de hof van olijven - Christ kneeling in pain in the garden while the angel is sent to Him, I am in pain and distress, let Your salvation protect me
pictures.name: pd_bellini_gebed_in_de_hof_van_olijven
